topic: No guided on-ramp into a new genre
unmet_need: Staged, goal-based exploration that coaches you into a genre
example_quotes: Great music app with plenty of songs and playlists. It is easy to discover music and create playlists for different moods
A comfort-to-curiosity dial is genius. The biggest gap in every recommender is control over how far the recs stretch.
I hate this app so much. I get like 5 ads after every song. Also, 3 out of 4 of Broadway Homestucks' albums have been removed.
trying to get into jazz but i keep bouncing off it. i need a guided on-ramp not a 5 hour playlist someone help
Recommendations feel random and disconnected from my taste. There's no thread connecting the new song to what I actually listen to.
Guided genre missions get into jazz over 3 weeks with a staged on-ramp would be a game changer for beginners.
Can we get better tools to actually explore? Genre radio all sounds the same and the recommendations never push me anywhere genuinely new.
Trying to get into classical as a total beginner and Spotify is no help. I need a beginner friendly path, not a firehose of 500 composers.

topic: Stuck in a listening loop / same songs on repeat
unmet_need: Gentle nudges that expand the rotation without losing comfort
research_question: Q4 repeat-listening of the same content
example_quotes: The same 50 songs on repeat problem is so real. I love them but I'm in a loop and the app does nothing to gently expand it.
Please add a slider to control how adventurous the recommendations are. Some days I want comfort, some days a real stretch.
Stuck listening to the same 50 songs on repeat. The app never nudges me out of my comfort playlist, so I'm in a rut.
Stuck-in-a-loop is so real. People fall back on the same songs on repeat; the product that breaks that rut wins.
Honestly I listen to the same 50 songs on repeat. I want new music but I have zero energy to go looking for it after work and kids.
stuck in a rut listening to the same songs on repeat and the algorithm refuses to break me out of the loop
give me a dial for how adventurous my recs are. some days i want comfort, some days i want a real stretch
I used to crate dig for hours. After kids I just loop the same comfort songs. I miss discovering but the effort barrier is too high now.

topic: New music never sticks (discovery without adoption)
unmet_need: Reinforcement that converts a first play into a lasting habit
research_question: Q4 / core: adoption, not one-off plays
example_quotes: As an aspirational explorer I save tons of new music and forget all of it. Retention and rotation are the real unmet need.
The killer feature would be adoption tracking. Most discovery never converts into a lasting habit a first play is not a win.
New music never sticks for me. I play a recommended song once and forget it it never makes it into my rotation.
Busy mom, two kids, I want new music that fits my existing taste delivered to me with zero effort. I will not go digging. Bring it to me.
as a busy parent i have zero time to crate dig. i just want good new music to come to me with no effort
Why does every recommended playlist sound the same as my current rotation? I feel stuck in a rut and the app is not helping me break out of it.
Every recommendation feels like a stranger. I'd try way more new music if there was a clear bridge from an artist I already love to the new one.
For me discovery works for a day then I forget the new artist exists. There's no follow up, no reinforcement, so it never sticks into my rotation.

topic: Discovery surfaces don't lead anywhere new

discover weekly used to find me artists i'd never have found myself. now it's all safe picks i already know. discovery is broken
Good app but discovery recommends stuff so safe and cautious it's boring. I never find anything genuinely new.
My discover weekly is stale. Every week it's the same vibe and the same handful of artists. I'm bored of it.
Discover Weekly used to be magic, now it just feeds me songs I already have saved. I never actually discover anything new from it anymore.
Power user here, I want obscure deep cuts and the algorithm refuses to go below a certain popularity threshold. Discovery for nerds is broken.

unmet_need: Genuinely novel recommendations that expand taste, not reinforce it
example_quotes: As a busy parent with two kids I have no time or energy to crate dig. I just want low-effort discovery that comes to me.
I have ADHD and the firehose of new releases is completely overwhelming. Discovery is way too high-effort to keep up with.
The algorithm is an echo chamber. It reinforces what I already play instead of expanding my taste into new artists.
Same here. The algorithm keeps recommending the same five artists over and over. It feels like an echo chamber, not discovery.
Discovery is a one shot thing. There's no sense of progress, no goal, no feeling that I'm actually growing my taste over time.
I just want a control slider comfort versus curiosity instead of a fixed algorithm deciding how adventurous I get.

spotify discover weekly is just my own playlist read back to me at this point. same artists every single week, total echo chamber

unmet_need: A clear bridge explaining why a track fits your existing taste
example_quotes: I love how Spotify will curate music based on my taste and get it right!!

Add back previews for songs in iMessage. Spotifys old 1530 second previews when sharing songs through messaging apps made music discovery dramatically easier. Friends could send a song to a group chat and everyone could immediately hear a short preview without opening Spotify. This encouraged me to listen to music outside my normal genres and discover songs recommended by friends. Please bring back playable previews when Spotify songs are shared through messaging apps

Add feedback option for Daily Mixes and Made for You playlists. Artist Radio used to be one of Spotifys best discovery tools. If I selected an artist, I would get music genuinely related to that artist and discover new artists. Over the last 12 years it increasingly gives me songs Spotify already knows I listen to, regardless of the artist I started with. Daily Mixes have also become repetitive and overlap heavily with each other. Please give users a setting for discovery vs familiarity and make Artist Radio primarily based on the selected artist rather than my overall listening history

Interactive Football Shirts with Spotify Codes. Dear Team, I noticed that you sponsor several football teams, with your logo featured on their jerseys. I would like to propose an innovative idea: adding a scannable Spotify Code directly onto the shirt, which links directly to a specific track on the Spotify app. Under this concept, each player would have their favorite song on their jersey, allowing fans to instantly discover and listen to it. This initiative would help drive new users and engagement to the music platform. Furthermore, through strategic partnerships with artists, it could also serve as a unique promotional channel for releasing new tracks. Thank you very much for your time and consideration. Emma

songless. Hello Spotify Team, Im a Spotify user and I would love to see Songless become available on Spotify in the future. For anyone who doesnt know it, Songless is a music guessing game where players try to identify a song based on clues and their knowledge of music. Its simple, fun, and encourages players to discover and listen to different songs and artists. I think this concept would be a great fit for Spotify because the game is directly connected to music. Having Songless on Spotify could make the platform more interactive and give users a fun way to discover new music. Please consider bringing Songless to Spotify. I would definitely play it if it became available! Thank you for listening to user feedback. Best regards, A Songless fan

Please add official Spotify Charts / Top 50 for Madagascar". Hello Spotify Team and Community, I am writing to request the addition of official Spotify Charts (Top 50 Daily and Viral 50) for Madagascar. Currently, many African countries have their own dedicated charts, but Madagascar is missing. The local music scene is booming, with incredible talent in urban music and Afro-pop. Local artists and listeners need an official, dynamic daily chart to discover what is trending in real-time, just like users in other countries can. Right now, the "Popular in Madagascar" section is too static. Having a real Top 50 would help local artists gain visibility and motivate more people in Madagascar to subscribe to Spotify. Please vote for this idea to support the Malagasy music community! Thank you!

Social Listening Mode. Id love to see a simple ON/OFF switch for a Social Listening Mode . When Im listening to music alone, Spotify should work normally and use my personal taste and listening history. But when Im listening with other people, I should be able to switch to Social Mode, where Spotify temporarily adapts its recommendations and queue to the tastes of the people Im listening with. Most importantly, music played in Social Mode shouldnt significantly influence my personal recommendations afterwards. This would make listening together much easier: I could discover and enjoy music with friends or my partner without having to worry about messing up my Spotify algorithm. It could even use the existing Blend concept to identify the groups tastes, but with a simple switch that clearly tells Spotify: Im listening for myself vs. Im listening with others.

Show Me Whos Playing in My City. Give users a location-based live music discovery feed. Spotify should let me discover what live music is happening around me , even if I'm not already following the artist. Let me explore by: Date City/location Venue Potentially genre or my listening profile Start high-level, then zoom in: State city date venue show The important distinction is discovery . I don't necessarily need Spotify to tell me when my favorite artist is touring. I want Spotify to answer: What's happening tonight that I might love? I had a free night. It was amazing. I found my new favorite band. Product rationale Spotify already has live-event information, so this feels like a potentially quick extension of existing data rather than inventing an entirely new system. Could build on existing live-event data/quick win Related idea This is part of a broader concept around making Spotify the place where music is discovered, experienced, and sharednot just listened to
